name: M5Stack ATOM Lite
description: 24 x 24 mm ESP32-PICO-D4 (4 MB flash) cube with USB-C, SK6812 RGB LED, button, IR LED and Grove port for $7.50; a tiny, ready-to-use ESP32 with a case.
notes: Exposed pins: G19, G21, G22, G23, G25, G33 on the bottom header plus Grove G26/G32 (hence ADC 4, touch 2, DAC on G25/G26). Other GPIOs go to the button (G39), SK6812 LED (G27) and IR LED (G12).
ESP32-PICO-D4 has Wi-Fi + Bluetooth Classic/BLE and 4 MB in-package flash; USB-UART bridge on USB-C. Needs 5 V / 500 mA.
Sibling boards: Atom Matrix (5x5 LED + IMU), Atom Echo (speaker/mic), AtomS3 (S3).
